view.chat.name: Chat
view.sessions.name: Sessions
config.server.autoStart: Start a local mux server when none is reachable.
config.server.port: The mux server port. 0 uses the extension default (8710).
config.server.path: The mux executable name or full path.
config.defaultEndpoint: The endpoint runs execute against. Empty uses the server's default.
config.approvalPosture: How mutating tools are handled during a run.
config.approvalPosture.prompt: Prompt in the editor before running a mutating tool.
config.approvalPosture.autoSafe: Auto-approve read-only tools; deny mutating ones.
config.context.sources: The editor context attached to a run by default.
config.locale: Display language override (BCP 47). Empty follows the editor language.
